info.notAllowedContent: We do not allow content that:

cats.eating: Unhealthy eating and extreme body image

counterfeit.fakeProducts_b1: Manufacturing, distributing, or selling brand counterfeit products
counterfeit.fakeProducts_b2: Intentionally blurring or hiding brand names or logos
counterfeit.fakeProducts_b3: Written or spoken messages, as well as behavior suggesting the sale of counterfeit products
counterfeit.lookalike_b1: “Fakes” that imitate trademarks, logos, color schemes, packaging, product design, or the overall look of genuine brand goods
counterfeit.lookalike_b2: Products that copy the design of the original brand, whether or not they use a similar logo or trademark
counterfeit.other_b1: Using copyrighted material without the rights holder’s permission
counterfeit.other_b2: Using patents or designs, or both, without the intellectual property owner’s permission
counterfeit.other_b3: Any form of misleading conduct intended to confuse or deceive users primarily to sell copyright-infringing products

violence.childExploit: Exploitation or abuse of people under 18
violence.physicalThreats: Physical violence and threats of violence

hate.hateSpeech_b1: Shows or promotes violence, discrimination, and other harmful acts, including supremacy claims based on personal characteristics such as race, religion, gender, and sexual orientation
hate.hateSpeech_b2: Degrades others based on these personal characteristics, including using hateful slurs
hate.hateSpeech_b3: Denies documented historical events that harm protected groups, such as the Holocaust
hate.hateSpeech_b4: Promotes or supports content, individuals, and organizations that encourage hateful ideology
hate.bullyingSelf: I have been bullied or harassed
hate.bullyingSelf_b1: Shows, promotes, or threatens to insult someone, including using profanity or demeaning language to humiliate them
hate.bullyingSelf_b2: Shows, promotes, or threatens to harass or bully others, physically or in any other form, including coordinated harassment
hate.bullyingSelf_b3: Shows, promotes, or threatens acts such as collecting information, blackmail, disclosing or soliciting disclosure of private or sensitive information
hate.bullyingSomeoneIKnow: I know someone who has been bullied or harassed
hate.bullyingCelebrity: A celebrity or government official has been bullied or harassed
hate.bullyingOthers: Others have been bullied or harassed

suicide.b1: We want Vibely to be a place where emotionally complex topics can be discussed openly without increasing the risk of harm.
suicide.b2: We do not allow showing, promoting, or sharing plans for suicide or self-harm. If you or someone you know is struggling, we are here to help. Please contact a suicide prevention helpline or emergency services.
suicide.b3: We also do not allow content that promotes disordered eating, dangerous weight-control behaviors, or the sale and marketing of weight-related products and services with harmful claims. If you or someone you know is concerned about body image, food, or exercise, please contact a local helpline.

eating.b1: Shows or promotes unhealthy eating practices, such as extreme dieting, fasting, binge eating, intentional vomiting, and other dangerous weight-loss behaviors, including excessive exercise and use of potentially harmful drugs and supplements
eating.b2: Shows or promotes unhealthy body-measurement trends

dangerous.b1: Shows or promotes dangerous activities, games, challenges, stunts, or actions that cause or could cause serious physical harm or property damage, such as improper use of dangerous tools, toxic substances, and dangerous driving
dangerous.b2: Ceremonial tools such as spears and shields are allowed in religious festivals and cultural performances.

nudity.youthSexual: Sexual activity, solicitation, and exploitation of minors
nudity.youthSexual_b1: Shows or promotes child sexual abuse material (CSAM) or sexual activity involving minors
nudity.youthSexual_b2: Shows or promotes nudity of minors
nudity.youthSexual_b3: Promotes or normalizes sexual exploitation, sexual abuse of minors, and pedophilia, including grooming, sextortion, and child sexual abuse
nudity.youthSexual_b4: Shows or promotes sexual exploitation, including inviting people under 18 to sexual activity, meeting off-platform, and sharing pornographic images, even when the initiator is also under 18
nudity.youthSexual_b5: Objectifies or sexualizes people under 18 through imagery or in-app interactive features
nudity.youthSuggestive_b1: Exposes most of a minor’s body
nudity.youthSuggestive_b3: Direct or indirect references to minors’ gender and sexual activity
nudity.youthSuggestive_b4: Some non-sexual content showing areolas or nipples is allowed in medical, educational, or culturally accepted contexts. Some body exposure is allowed in culturally expected contexts, such as athletes in sportswear or people in swimwear at the beach.
nudity.adultSexual: Adult sexual activity, services, and solicitation
nudity.adultSexual_b1: Invites or requests becoming a sexual partner or engaging in sexual behavior
nudity.adultSexual_b2: Explicit sexual content, including pornography showing intercourse, masturbation, and vivid depictions of sexual behavior
nudity.adultNudity_b1: Adult nudity, including photographs and digitally created images (such as manga and anime)
nudity.adultNudity_b2: Some non-sexual content showing areolas or nipples is allowed in medical, educational, culturally accepted, or culturally expected contexts, such as breastfeeding or celebratory festivals (like holidays).
nudity.pornLanguage_b1: Explicit sexual narration, such as vivid descriptions of sexual behavior by adults or people under 18

shocking.b2: Human or animal body parts that are dismembered, destroyed, burned, incinerated, or severely injured
shocking.b3: Some content is allowed in educational, artistic, or professional contexts, such as professional combat sports.

misinfo.election_b1: Misinformation about how to vote or run for office
misinfo.dangerous_b1: Misinformation that endangers public safety or may cause panic, such as using old footage of a past event and claiming it is current, or spreading inaccurate claims that essentials like food or water are gone
misinfo.dangerous_b2: Medical information that risks public health, such as false vaccine claims, as well as inaccurate medical advice that discourages people from receiving appropriate care
misinfo.dangerous_b3: Climate change misinformation contrary to long-standing scientific consensus, such as denying that climate change exists
misinfo.dangerous_b4: Dangerous conspiracy theories that promote violence, hatred, or target individuals, such as theories that create prejudice against a specific group or cause harm
misinfo.deepfake: Deepfakes, synthetic media, and manipulated media
misinfo.deepfake_b1: Synthetic or manipulated media showing real scenes that are not fully disclosed or labeled in the video
misinfo.deepfake_b2: Synthetic media containing a likeness (image or audio) of a real person when used in political or commercial endorsements, or if it violates our Community Guidelines
misinfo.deepfake_b3: Material edited in ways that mislead others about real events
misinfo.deepfake_b4: Synthetic media showing a public figure is allowed in artistic or educational contexts, such as a celebrity performing a popular dance, or a historical figure appearing in a history lesson.

spam.fakeEngagement_b1: Provides instructions or promotes methods or services that help users increase artificial engagement, such as selling followers or likes
spam.spamMail_b1: Accounts used in bulk or via unauthorized automation such as bots to distribute large amounts of content, including for commercial purposes
spam.spamMail_b2: Networks of accounts that claim to be similar entities or post similar content to steer users to specific places on or off Vibely, such as other accounts, websites, and businesses

controlled.gambling_b1: Gambling services such as casinos, poker, slot machines, roulette, lotteries, betting tips, as well as gambling-related software and apps
controlled.substances_b1: Shows young people possessing, using, or trading alcohol, tobacco, drugs, or other controlled substances
controlled.substances_b2: Shows or promotes recreational adult use of drugs or other controlled substances
controlled.substances_b3: Shows or promotes abuse of common household products or over-the-counter drugs to get high, such as antihistamines and glue sniffing
controlled.substances_b4: Provides instructions on how to distill spirits, manufacture drugs, or other controlled substances
controlled.substances_b5: Facilitates trading or purchasing alcohol, tobacco, drugs, or other controlled substances
controlled.weapons_b1: Shows or promotes guns or explosive weapons not used in a safe or appropriate context
controlled.weapons_b2: Facilitates trading or provides instructions on how to manufacture guns or explosive weapons
controlled.otherTrade: Trading other controlled goods and services
controlled.otherTrade_b1: Trading counterfeit money and documents as well as stolen information
controlled.otherTrade_b2: Trading wildlife and any parts of endangered animals, such as products and medicines made from ivory

fraud.b1: Vibely is a place to learn and engage with many topics; we do not allow anyone to take advantage of that.
fraud.b2: We do not allow any conduct that scams, deceives, or takes others’ property, including assisting financial scams, impersonating celebrities to sell products or contact users, or any other form of fraud.
fraud.b3: We also do not allow accounts that mislead or attempt to manipulate the platform, or trade services that increase artificial engagement or game the recommendation system.

personalInfo.b1: Sharing personal phone numbers and home addresses
personalInfo.b2: Sharing financial and payment information, such as bank accounts and credit card numbers
personalInfo.b3: Sharing login credentials, such as usernames and passwords
personalInfo.b4: Sharing identity documents or identification numbers, such as passports and social security numbers

ip.counterfeitSuspect: Suspected infringement of someone else’s rights

originality.titleBlock: Non-original, low-quality, or QR content — posting blocked
originality.body: To keep the positive experience users expect on Vibely, non-original and low-quality content is not eligible for recommendation. Non-original content is content that is only imported or copied from another source without new creative edits. A video may be non-original if it has a watermark or logo. Low-quality content includes very short videos, still images, and GIF-only videos.

originality.blockedDetail: This video cannot be posted because it is suspected to be non-original. Please replace it with another video.
originality.limitedDetail: You can still post, but editing it to follow our guidelines may improve visibility.
